channel: ASCII NUL-terminated C literals, C Tcl_EvalEx length -1 with TCL_EVAL_DIRECT; Jim_Eval

cases.source: set x OLD; after 0 {set x NEW}; vwait x; set x
set {-all} OLD; after 0 {set {-all} NEW}; vwait -all; set {-all}
set {-signal} OLD; after 0 {set {-signal} NEW}; vwait -signal; set {-signal}
set {--} OLD; after 0 {set {--} NEW}; vwait -- --; set {--}
set x OLD; after 0 {set x NEW}; vwait -variable x -timeout 100; set x
set x OLD; after 0 {set x NEW}; vwait -v x -t 100; set x
set x OLD; after 0 {set x NEW}; vwait -signal x; set x
set x SAME; after 0 {set x SAME}; vwait x {break}
set x SAME; after 0 {set x SAME}; vwait -signal x {break}
set {-sig} OLD; after 0 {set {-sig} NEW}; vwait -sig x; set {-sig}
set x OLD; namespace eval N {variable x LOCAL}; after 0 {set x GLOBAL}; namespace eval N {vwait x}; list [namespace eval N {set x}] $x
